verdict.rationale: Brex, a SaaS spend-management platform, documents an official MCP server on its developer site. A probe confirmed the page exists. The docs say it lets AI assistants manage expenses, look up users, check cards, review banking transactions and track bills through natural language. Missing for 10: documented connection/setup and authentication steps for the MCP server, an explicit tool list, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting.
